question:
From the options given below choose the synonym (similar meaning) of the word:

Ossified
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ossified"** means something that has turned into bone or become rigid and fixed in position. (हड्डी में बदलना या कठोर होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The once flexible policies have **ossified **over time, making change difficult.
 
 
 
• **"Harden" **refers to making or becoming hard or harder. (कठोर बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The concrete takes several hours to **harden** completely.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Ossified'** is **'Harden'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amenable **(अनुकूल): Open and responsive to suggestion; easily persuaded or controlled.

 
 
• **Example:** She was **amenable **to the idea of extending the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Docile **(शांत): Ready to accept control or instruction; submissive.
 
 
• **Example: **The **docile** puppy quickly learned to obey commands.
 
 
 
• **Pliant** (लचीला): Easily bent or flexible.
 
 
• **Example:** The material used in the sculpture was very **pliant.**
 
 

35:Td90,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
